stations.title: Femi
stations.say: Three edits, none of them saved.
stations.note: One of them may have a typo.

stations.title: Working folder
stations.text: New books, a phone number, a new page.

captions: Femi worked on the shop's site on Saturday and left three changes uncommitted.
Saved together, they would be one lump, with a typo and an unread page inside.
You choose what goes into each commit and fix the typo first, in three tasks.
Two clean commits, and the new page waits in the staging area for Wilma.
Each change went its own way through the three places.
